name: RenewNetworkPackages

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The renewal duration. Valid values of this parameter are determined by the value of the `PeriodUnit` parameter.

If `PeriodUnit` is set to `Week`, the valid value is 1.
If `PeriodUnit` is set to `Month`, valid values are 1, 2, 3, and 6.
If `PeriodUnit` is set to `Year`, valid values are 1, 2, and 3.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
续费时长。取值范围由参数`PeriodUnit`的值决定。

`PeriodUnit`为`Week`时，取值范围为：1。
`PeriodUnit`为`Month`时，取值范围为：1、2、3、6。
`PeriodUnit`为`Year`时，取值范围为：1、2、3。

默认值：1
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The unit of the renewal duration
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable automatic payment
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en: The IDs of premium Internet bandwidth plans. You can specify 1 to 100 IDs
parameters.help_zh: 公网精品带宽ID列表。可设置1~100个
parameters.name: network_package_id

parameters.help_en: The user ID for resource ownership in the reseller pattern. You do not need to specify this parameter if you are not using the reseller pattern
parameters.help_zh: 转售模式的资源归属用户ID，非转售模式无需填写该参数
parameters.name: reseller_owner_uid

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal for subscription shared cloud desktops
parameters.help_zh: 是否为包年包月共享型云电脑开启自动续费
parameters.name: auto_renew
